stem.text: Monochromatic light is directed at a diffraction grating, as shown.

stem.alt: Horizontal arrow pointing right at a vertical dashed line representing a diffraction grating.

stem.text: Which diagram could show all the possible directions of the light, after passing through the grating, that give maximum intensity?

A.alt: Vertical dashed line with two arrows leaving it, one up and to the right and one down and to the right.

B.alt: Vertical dashed line with several arrows leaving it to the right in different directions.

C.alt: Vertical dashed line with several arrows leaving it to the right in different directions.

D.alt: Vertical dashed line with three nearly horizontal arrows leaving it to the right.
